phases.title: Use cases: the waiting list, search, one drop-off and rejection
phases.notes: pytest 1626 passed, 99.56%; privacy: staff use cases take no verified caller by design (decision 0002 checks token and ceramics group at the console route); phase 8 review must block any console route, including the preview photo route, without that check and tests for no token and a token outside the group; search text must stay out of URLs (POST)

phases.title: Use cases: loads, settings, close, counts
phases.notes: From 2c privacy review: the sender must re-read photos by the same drop-off key as the recipient (or outgoing checks all refs share one drop-off ID); to must be drop_off.contact.email re-read by key, and the test email goes only to the signed-in staff member; from 2d review: decide MAY_HAVE_GONE for a FAILED rejection email whose send may have left (code unexpected, or a lost SES response), so an undo never tells staff not to contact someone who may have the email
